scope: The eight files named as next by M37 (seven src/apps/* CLI front-ends and src/asn1_dsa.rs). Contract checks against OpenSSL 3.6.4 for argument-string lifetimes, file/BIO ownership on every exit including option refusals, option-array bounds, error tails, allocation arithmetic, getter-returned and body-owned raw pointers, and the borrowed Packet cursor contracts. Five resource/compatibility defects across four files repaired; no memory-safety defect found.
worktree: source: src/apps/ts.rs, src/apps/verify.rs and src/apps/storeutl.rs repaired; src/apps/{speed,spkac,version,x509}.rs and src/asn1_dsa.rs audited with no source change. queue/receipt: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 42 and this file.

reconciliation.method: AUDITED-FILES.txt is the union of each mechanism sweep's structured .files array, the M1 files, the structured per-file records and each boundary sweep's structured boundaries. The eight files added here were the first eight entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and were inserted in the file's existing sorted order.
reconciliation.difference_from_341: M37 left 341 audited / 422 unaudited. This batch moves the eight files it named as next; no skipped boundary was removed from the remaining queue.

file_dispositions.note: The fetched method is released once; EVP_MD_free refuses the legacy/static origin, so the fallback release is a no-op. Every option arm returns before the benchmark boundary.

inb, conf, spki, out and pkey are released once on every return. A NULL NETSCAPE_SPKI_get_pubkey result reaches the library's NULL-refusal arms exactly as the authority's unchecked use. _passin is the helper's NULL block.

After the load loop the transcription reopened out, which apps/storeutl.c:507 does not. With zero loaded items it created the -out file and wrote 'Total found: 0', where the authority leaves out NULL and its BIO_vprintf refuses. The reopen is removed.

query_command opened a data/stdin BIO before refusing the unlanded -digest hex arm; the arm check now precedes the open, matching the authority's 'digest == NULL && (data_bio = ...)'. default_config_file dropped the CONF_get1_default_config_file block; it is now adopted with OwnedBlock at the (NULL, 0) seam. main's two config-failure arms returned after opt_md fetched an EVP_MD without releasing it; both now free it.

vpm was allocated before the option loop but released only on the final arm, leaking it on every parse refusal/not_landed return. VpmGuard now gives every exit the authority's single end: release, in the authority's order (vpm, then store).
CStr::from_ptr is used only on the documented never-NULL static version string.

mechanisms: X509_get0_pubkey / issuer / subject / serial / notBefore / notAfter
file_dispositions.note: pkey and the name/time/serial pointers are borrowed from live x; the SHA-1 digest length is bounded by EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE (64); out and x are released once on every return.

mechanisms: borrowed Packet cursor (get_1, get_net_2, get_bytes, get_sub)
file_dispositions.note: Every advance is guarded by remaining; buf_init refuses len > SIZE_MAX/2; the sub-packet borrow is a prefix of the parent; offset_from stays within the caller's slice. The dsa/sign.rs callers establish the documented precondition. Caller/dependency closure remains a BOUNDARY obligation.

defects.detail: query_command opened a data/stdin BIO before returning for the unlanded -digest hex arm, leaking it on every such run. The arm check now precedes the open, matching apps/ts.c:427-433.
default_config_file converted the CONF_get1_default_config_file block to String and dropped the original allocation. It is now adopted with OwnedBlock at the (NULL, 0) seam, the configutl adoption.
After opt_md fetched an EVP_MD, the 'default config not landed' and config-load-failure arms returned without EVP_MD_free(md); the authority's end: releases it on both. Both arms now free it.

vpm was allocated before the option loop but released only on the final arm, so every parse refusal and not_landed return leaked it. VpmGuard now gives every exit one release, matching apps/verify.c's end: label.

After the loop the transcription reopened out; with zero loaded items it created the -out file and wrote 'Total found: 0', where apps/storeutl.c:507 leaves out NULL and BIO_vprintf refuses. The reopen is removed.
